notes:
## New features & enhancements

- **Firefox plays every station now.** It has no built-in support for HLS, the stream type KISS 92.5 and CBC use, so they never connected there. Firefox now plays them through a small library that loads only when it is needed; Chrome and Edge are untouched.
- **Firefox opens at the radio's size**, centred, instead of whatever size it last remembered. It goes through the same launcher as Chrome and Edge, so it also gets the daily update check.
- In Firefox the window still cannot be locked, and the big window cannot step aside when you pin the mini radio: Firefox does not let a page move or resize its own window.

## Bug fixes

- **Start with Windows opened the wrong radio for Edge users.** It always used Chrome's profile, so it opened a different set of stations — or, on a PC without Chrome, none at all. It now opens the same radio as the desktop shortcut you use.
